refill.why: Good phrase, but the one USE slot went to U03.
자리 is a loose rendering of bwrdd (table), so the Korean may not lead to this Welsh; the slot is already filled.
'Arwain y ffordd flwyddyn nesa' (lead the way next year) is an odd thing to say after a yes-answer; the slot is already filled.
'Yes, they can help, but they're not ready' contradicts itself.
'Ond medran, mi fedran nhw' (but yes, they can) is unnatural with 'ond' before the yes-answer.
Long and awkward, and the slot is already filled.
